name: Footer
_comment: Footer group — client spec 2026-08-13. Four columns:
Shop      All fragrances · Original Creations · Layering · Gifting
The House The Oasis · The Ingredients · The Craft · The House
Follow    Instagram · TikTok · Facebook · WhatsApp — as ICONS
Column 2 uses Fueguia's four-pillar naming (DIRECTION.md Part 1 §2.4).
The link lists are Shopify NAVIGATION MENUS, not typed-in blocks —
menu structure is edited under Navigation in the admin so there is one
place to change it. Create menus named `footer-shop`, `footer-house`
and `footer-help`, then pick them in the theme editor.
Base line: © 2026 Siwa Fragrances · سيوة  /  Made in Egypt.
The Arabic here is the brand lockup, the same sanctioned exception as
the header wordmark — not doubled content.
